offering_description.value: Cass audits and pays freight, utility and other operating invoices for businesses, and turns invoice data into spending reports. It also provides payment processing for business software providers and offers loans, deposit accounts and cash management through Cass Commercial Bank to privately held businesses and religious organizations.

primary_services.value: Freight invoice auditing and payment; utility and waste invoice processing; expense reporting and analytics; business payment processing; commercial banking
